description: A chord per half beat on rhythm's beat grid, from tonal's tuning-referenced treble and bass profiles: template scores over a vocabulary of eighteen qualities, a bass-root bonus, slash bass notes, and a Viterbi path that pays for every change; with the two runner-up chords of each span. NumPy only; decodes nothing.

chords.description: spans tiling the recording, cut where the chord or the bass line changes; label: root, quality (maj is no suffix; m, 7, maj7, m7, m7b5, dim, dim7, aug, sus2, sus4, 6, m6, add9, 9, m9, maj9, m11) and /bass when the bass line's note is not the root (Abmaj7/Bb), or N where the stretch is not pitched; value: the chord's mean score (cosine with its template plus the bass-root bonus, less its penalty), none for N

chord_candidates.description: three spans per chord span, with its start and end and in the chords' order: the three chords scoring highest over it, the chord named first, each over the span's bass note; value: mean score

changes_per_minute.description: chord changes per minute of chord time (not N); 0 when there is none

beat_share.description: share of the chord time between two tracked beats one beat apart, rather than on the grid filled in at the median beat interval; 0 when there is no chord time
